usage: Usually used for the edible part of a plant, especially when talking about harvesting or identifying produce.
Common in gardening, farming, and biology contexts; it sounds a bit more specific and bookish than 日日講嘅一般‘fruit’.
Can be used for both one fruit and fruits in general; context tells you whether it is singular or plural.
Often appears with words about plants, trees, seeds, ripening, and plant growth.
